title: SIMD F_5 plus F_7 kernels in gf2-kernels-simd
description:
Instantiate the generic `BatchedBipedalLike` framework (T16) for F_5 and F_7 in `gf2-kernels-simd`, with proptest cross-checks against the scalar packed types.

## Background

Once T16 (the generic framework) and T17/T19 (per-prime packed types and op formulas) are in place, the SIMD kernels are a small wiring task: define `BipedalLikeConfig` impls for F_5 and F_7, instantiate `BatchedBipedalLike` for each, expose lane-batch primitives that `gf2-algebra` dispatches to.

Same `unsafe` and asm-artefact rules as T12.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `gf2-kernels-simd::bipedal::packed5` and `gf2-kernels-simd::bipedal::packed7` modules exist with `BipedalLikeConfig` impls and AVX2 instantiations.
- [ ] [hard] Lane-batch `add`, `sub`, `mul`, `neg` proptest-match scalar `Packed5`/`Packed7` ops on 1000 random inputs each.
- [ ] [hard] Runtime AVX2 detection wires through; scalar fallback when absent.
- [ ] [hard] `cargo nextest run -p gf2-kernels-simd --release --profile ci` passes.
- [ ] [hard] `asm-artefact-present` gate passes for both kernels.
- [ ] [aspirational] AVX-512 paths exist for both primes, gated behind `cfg(target_feature = "avx512f")`.
